notes: Kept all three planned kinds. Wall mirror gained six archetypes (Ultrafragola, sunburst with Line Vautrin and Chaty Vallauris versions, Venetian, girandole/convex, Adnet Circulaire, overmantel); floor mirror gained the cheval archetype and its old empty source now cites the Cheval glass article; IKEA models refreshed from the retrieved IKEA mirrors page. Table mirror has types only plus one IKEA model. Left out: a Venetian/Murano mirror tradition entry (Murano glass is better handled on the vases/glass shelf; no dedicated retrieved source for mirror-making), Line Vautrin and Chaty Vallauris as brand entries (designer/workshop versions under a maker-free archetype), the Zieta Sonar as an archetype (kept as a flat model, no page retrieved). Wikipedia pages for Ultrafragola and Line Vautrin returned 404.
